dedupe_keys.name: urbangency ecuador emergency event tweet identifiers and annotations

description: UrbangEnCy supplies identifiers and annotations for more than 25,500 Spanish-language Twitter posts about emergency and non-emergency events in continental Ecuador. Jorge Parraga-Alava and collaborators collected posts from 19 January to 19 August 2020, using geographic and keyword filters, then assigned emergency labels and service categories. Mendeley version 2 lists a delimiter-separated file and five annotator spreadsheets, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage excludes the Galapagos Islands and reflects selected public social-media posts, not all emergency incidents. The availability statement explicitly withholds tweet text, posted dates and locations; recovering those fields requires separate platform access and surviving posts. These are material limitations for event reconstruction. Modellers could test how classification uncertainty affects simulated emergency-detection and response demand. data-colombia-solid-waste-tweets is a related citizen-report resource from another country and service domain. No tweet was retrieved, rehydrated or downloaded, and the annotations were not treated as verified incident records.
